title: dunbaria glandulosa
intro: Dunbaria glandulosa, commonly known as the Dunbaria plant, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Fabaceae family. This plant has been found to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Dunbaria glandulosa include its ability to treat wounds, fever, and respiratory problems due to its analgesic, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Dunbaria glandulosa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
